The '''Geris system''' was located in the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was occupied by the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geris VI]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Geris system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
